name: SlopGuard
tagline: Architecture-agnostic agent that hunts security holes, AI slop, coding gaps and loose ends - with Claude-powered triage.
author: joshhh62
description: SlopGuard scans any repository (30+ languages and config formats) with 38 precision-tuned detectors across four classes - security, AI slop, coding gaps and loose ends - including hallucinated-dependency (slopsquatting) and prompt-injection detection. An optional Claude agent then triages every candidate with sandboxed read-only tools: it confirms or dismisses findings, corrects severity, writes tailored fixes, reports issues the rules missed and produces an executive summary. Outputs console, Markdown, HTML, JSON and SARIF, with CI gating, diff mode and baselines.
features: Web dashboard (slopguard serve): scan a GitHub URL or local folder, interactive charts, hotspots, filters, exports
38 rules: security, AI slop, coding gaps, loose ends
Language-agnostic engine driven by a declarative language table, plus Python AST rules
Hallucinated / undeclared dependency detection (slopsquatting) for Python and JS/TS
Claude triage agent: sandboxed tools, secret redaction, budgets, graceful degradation
Console, Markdown, interactive HTML, JSON and SARIF 2.1.0 reports
